scheme_name: Scheme for Providing Employment Opportunities by Establishing Piggery, Sheep and Goat Units (General) under Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivaar Utthan Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must provide a Self-Declaration confirming unemployment and agreement to scheme conditions
Applicant must have a space or shed for keeping animals
No mandatory educational qualifications or training are required
Applicant must have taken a loan for establishing the specified piggery or sheep/goat unit
benefits_summary: Provides a 25% subsidy on livestock cost, up to ₹25,000 for a 10+1 piggery unit or up to ₹24,500 for a 15+1 sheep/goat unit.
